Kubelet syncs ConfigMap volumes via atomic rename + symlink swap, so watchers (inotify/fsnotify/polling) hot-reload without restart. Caveat: subPath mounts don't update. #kubernetes #configmap #hot-reload https://www.valtersit.com/vault/hotreload-configmap-changes-without-pod-restart-3a955a/
